releases.notes:
## viaLogium 1.0.0 - Minecraft 26.2 port

Port of the whole logging stack to the new MC line, following upstream Ledger ports (bf8192b, 8c6cfa4) adapted across our renamed tree: **41 files (+946/-579)**.

### Toolchain
- Minecraft **26.2**, official Mojang mappings (unobfuscated), Loom 1.17.x, Gradle 9.5.1
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3, Fabric API 0.152.1+26.2, Kotlin 2.3.10 / fabric-language-kotlin 1.13.9
- **Java 25** required

### Adaptations
- Mixin targets deobfuscated and re-verified via javap against the 26.2 merged jar (lambdas/method_ placeholders gone)
- Renamed vanilla classes covered: LilyPad, Farmland, Speleothem, CauldronInteractions, ContainerInput clicks, sign WrapOperation signature, ShowItem ItemStackTemplate hovers, ServerLevelEvents / serverboundPlay renames
- testmod fixed (broken even upstream): ClientCommandManager removal workaround
- viapanel API dependency isolated at `lib/mc26/` - requires viapanel **3.0.0+**

### Note
Mixin injection targets are compile-checked; a runtime smoke test on a real 26.2 server is recommended before production.

## viaLogium 0.4.0 - upstream sync

Ports the valuable fixes and features from upstream [Ledger](https://github.com/QuiltServerTools/Ledger) 1.3.19..1.3.23 (commits after our fork point), adapted to the viaLogium codebase.

### Fixed
- **MySQL**: action rows with `extra_data` exceeding the TEXT column limit are skipped with a warn instead of failing the entire batch (#371)
- Search result click actions (page change, teleport) now run on the server thread via custom click events dispatched after `ensureRunningOnSameThread` (#372, #361)
- Teleport click action no longer NPEs on unknown dimensions

### Added
- Declarative `actions(time)` + xyz indexes for fresh databases on all backends; legacy raw-exec migrations gated behind new `[database] updateSchema = false` option (#369, #375)
- Player names resolved from the local DB cache instead of per-query Mojang lookups (#357)
- Item insert/remove tracking for Chiseled Bookshelf (#368)

### Skipped
- Upstream #355 (@global range NPE) - already unreachable in viaLogium's search parameter handling.

**Requires:** Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader, Fabric API, fabric-language-kotlin. Optional: viapanel 2.9.0+.

releases.notes:
## viaLogium 0.3.0

Server-side world change logger for Fabric (Minecraft 1.21.11).
**Based on [Ledger](https://github.com/QuiltServerTools/Ledger) 1.3.18 by QuiltServerTools** (LGPL-3.0 carried over).

### Highlights of this fork

- **Hardened DB pipeline**: a transient database failure no longer kills the flush coroutine silently - failed batches retry (x5, 5 s apart) and `/vl status` shows `Logging: OK / DEGRADED`; save-off pauses are now visible in the log.
- **Opt-in piston movement logging**: `[actions] logPistons = false` by default; emits standard block actions with source `piston`, self-throttles under queue pressure.
- **viaPanel integration**: edit the config in-game when viapanel 2.9.0+ is installed.
- Rebranded to `vialogium` with `/vl` as the command root; Russian docs and Discord guides included.

### Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader
- `fabric-language-kotlin` and Fabric API in `mods/`
- Optional: `viapanel-2.9.0+` for panel UI
- Storage: SQLite out of the box; H2 / MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL supported

### Install

Drop the jar into `mods/`. Config is generated at `config/vialogium.toml` on first run.

*Full upstream history is preserved in the git log below the fork baseline commit.*
